correctness.rationale: Direct multiplication gives the determinant criterion exactly. Fibers of the quotient by scalar translations are cliques, so independence reduces to pairwise nonzero determinants. Every nonzero vector lies on a unimodular projective line by local prime-power factorization and the Chinese remainder theorem, which gives an injection from every determinant-independent set into the projective line. Determinant zero between two unimodular generators forces equality of their projective lines after an invertible change of basis, giving the reverse inequality. Counting unimodular vectors modulo unit scaling gives Dedekind psi. The checker verifies the structural claims for moduli \(2\) through \(40\) and exact reduced maxima for moduli \(2\) through \(6\).
